content_sections.heading: OIL Green Energy Recruitment 2026 Experience Details
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for OGEL Contractual Engagement Recruitment 2026 must possess relevant post-qualification experience as prescribed for each position. The experience requirement varies according to the role. Candidates should have more than 3 years of experience in finance, accounting, audit, financial reporting or related areas. Experience should be relevant to the finance function. Candidates should have more than 1 year of experience in corporate legal matters, contract management, litigation support or related legal areas. For the position carrying ₹80,000 monthly emoluments: More than 3 years of experience in procurement and contracting activities. For the position carrying ₹60,000 monthly emoluments: More than 2 years of experience in procurement and contracting activities. Candidates should have more than 3 years of experience as a Data Processing Executive. Experience in handling data, coordination and executive support activities will be relevant. Candidates should have more than 3 years of experience in civil execution work. Experience should be related to industrial projects. Candidates should have more than 3 years of company secretarial experience . Experience should include corporate compliance and secretarial activities. The post-wise experience requirements are mentioned in the official OGEL recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: OIL Green Energy Recruitment 2026 Salary / Contract Emoluments
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive fixed monthly contractual emoluments as mentioned in the OGEL recruitment notification. The monthly contractual emoluments are specified against each position in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: OIL Green Energy Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The engagement under OGEL Recruitment 2026 will be purely contractual in nature. The initial contract period will be 3 years . The contract may be extended by up to 1 additional year based on performance and business requirements. The engagement may also end earlier depending on completion of the project or requirement. Either party may terminate the contract by providing 30 days' notice. The contractual engagement does not provide any right or claim for permanent employment or regularisation in OGEL.

content_sections.heading: OIL Green Energy Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for OGEL contractual positions will be based on screening and personal interview. Application Screening Personal Interview Final Selection The interview will carry a total of 100 marks . Candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks to be considered for selection. The assessment during the interview will include: Professional Knowledge and Skills in the concerned discipline Professional Knowledge and Skills in allied discipline Personal Attributes Soft Skills
